texts.preamble: Aradhana Srivastava vs Vivek Virendra Singh on 9 May, 2024 In The Court Of Ms. Sheetal Chaudhary Pradhan Additional Sessions Judge-02, South-East District Saket Courts, New Delhi Criminal Appeal No. 09/2 Ps- C.R. P U/Sec. 29 Pwdv Ac In the matter of : Aradhana Srivastava W/o Sh. Vivek Virendra Singh R/o D-652, 2nd Floor, Chitranjan Park New Delhi- 110019 .... Appell Versus 1. Vivek Virendra Singh S/o Late Virendra Singh Chief Health Specialist R/o Unicef House, 73 Lodhi Estate New Delhi- 110003 2. Smt. Lata Virendra Singh S/o Late Sh. Virendra Singh R/o 244, C Block, Sector 105 Noida 201301
texts.facts: 3. As per record of Ld. Trial Court, the brief facts necessary for disposal of present appeal, are as follows :- "That marriage of the complainant/ petitioner was solemnized with respondent no. 1 on 10.05.2007 at Pune and another small ceremony was held at Allahabad on 24.08.2007 and thereafter he returned from an Unicef Project in Kenya. The CA No. 09/2024 Aradhana Srivastava Vs. Vivek Virendra Singh Page no. 2 of 13 marriage was registered at the office of Registrar of Marriages at Allahabad on 27.08.2007 and they stayed at shared household at Pune. It is alleged that since the beginning of marriage, complainant was treated with extreme mental cruelty by the respondents. Respondent no. 1 after four days of marriage, went to Kenya and complainant thereafter stayed with respondent no. 2 at Pune to lookafter her. Respondent no. 1 wanted complainant to join him at Kenya for honeymoon upon which respondent no. 2 got furious and did not allow complainant in this regard. Complainant was even not allowed to buy a new SIM Card for her mobile and was left to use the mobile phone of respondent no. 2 but only with her permission. While the respondent no. 1 was in Kenya, complainant called him on his mobile phone where a lady answered the said call and disconnected after that. Complainant kept on calling but all in vain. Upon the same, complainant got upset and the said incident was informed to the respondent no. 2 but she very candidly replied that Rajputs have the habit of keeping innumerable partners. Further, in the month of January 2008, respondent no. 2 underwent a surgery for hysterectomy and it was only the respondent no. 1 was in India for his CA No. 09/2024 Aradhana Srivastava Vs. Vivek Virendra Singh Page no. 3 of 13 mother's surgery and since the respondent no. 1 was doing his Master's from Atlanta, he had to leave after a week. Complainant's father was on death bed but the respondent no. 2 forced the complainant to leave her father and go with her to America. In the month of March 2008, complainant along-with respondent no. 2 went to America and took care of her. Complainant was forced to cook food just a week before her delivery, for visitors at home. Thereafter, being every day tortured by respondent no. 2 and respondent no. 1 providing no support, complainant requested the respondent no. 1 to shift her to his friend's place. Complainant gave birth to a girl child in USA on 06.07.2008 and respondent no. 2 was unhappy on birth of a girl child and constantly taunted the complainant in this regard. Thereafter, respondents started pressuring the complainant for a male child. On 12.03.2017, respondent no. 1 on the birth of Riyaan Singh, had brought his girlfriend Neha Singh with him and when complainant objected, respondent no. 1 instead of just sending his girlfriend away, decided to leave along-with her. Complainant has started making efforts to resume her career in law not out of choice Aradhana Srivastava vs Vivek Virendra Singh on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40890879/ 2 but sheer CA No. 09/2024 Aradhana Srivastava Vs. Vivek Virendra Singh Page no. 4 of 13 economic necessity since the sustenance provided by the respondent no. 1 was falling woefully short of meeting even the bare minimum expenditure of the household. Further, that respondent no. 1 has continuously been stalking or causing the complainant to be stalked by privately hired detectives and monitoring every movement of her to somehow establish that her career is causing damage to the children. The same has been causing her severe stress and anxiety resulting in serious and avoidable health issues. Respondent no. 1 has been living a luxurious and expensive lifestyle with all modern amenities. Complainant has been single handedly taking care of the children and is suffering from many ailments and also require to take care of every small requirement of the children. Further, in June 2021 the monthly salary of respondent no. 1 was Rs. 5,19,452.92 per month. Respondent no. 1 had a plot bearing no. 3 at Mont Vert Fairydale, Bavdhan, Pune, Maharasthra in the year 2011 and present value of the same is not less than Rs. 2 Crore. Respondent no. 1 is also having immovable properties i.e. H. No. 18-D, Moti Lal, Nehru Road, Allengunj, Allahabad. Father of respondent no. 1 died intestate and respondent no. 1 is having CA No. 09/2024 Aradhana Srivastava Vs. Vivek Virendra Singh Page no. 5 of 13 proportionate share in both the properties. It is prayed that maintenance to the tune of Rs. 2.5 Lacs per month and Rs. 5 Crore as compensation along-with litigation cost of Rs. 20 Lacs with the other reliefs, be granted to the complainant." 4. Ld. Trial Court vide impugned order dated 03.10.2023 granted interim relief as to maintenance, residence and medical expenses sought by the complainant including application u/sec. 23 DV Act and application u/sec. 151 CPC, that respondent no. 1 shall continue to pay the educational/ school fee of minor children by depositing the same directly to the school and also directed to pay Rs. 90,000/- for the maintenance of the complainant as well as minor children from the date of filing of the petition i.e. 06.06.2022 till the disposal of the case on merits, to the complainant. 5. Aggrieved to the impugned order dated 03.10.2023 passed by Ld. Trial Court, appellant has challenged the said order by way of present appeal. Appellant has taken following grounds to challenge impugned order passed by Ld. Trial Court :- i) That Ld. Trial Court failed to consider the complaint of complainant as it is totally vague in nature. CA No. 09/2024 Aradhana Srivastava Vs. Vivek Virendra Singh Page no. 6 of 13 iii) That Ld. Trial Court failed to consider the aspect that respondent no. 1 is deliberately concealing his real income and assets to avoid maintaining the appellant Aradhana Srivastava vs Vivek Virendra Singh on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40890879/ 3 and her minor children despite earning salary of Rs. 6,50,000/- excluding perks like HRA, Medical, Miscellaneous expenses as per actuals . iv) That respondent no.1 married in the year 2009 and was living with her until the year 2016 having two children from the said marriage. Respondent no. 1 is a womanizer and after marriage has been number of extra marital affairs. Respondent no. 1 got into an extra marital affair while the appellant was pregnant in the year 2016. Respondent no. 1 has neglected and avoided all his duties towards the appellant wife and the minor children. CA No. 09/2024 Aradhana Srivastava Vs. Vivek Virendra Singh Page no. 7 o v) That respondent no. 1 has abandoned the appellant and minor children since 2016 just to carry on his illicit love affair with Ms. Neha Singh and has shunned all his family responsibilities. vi) That respondent no. 1 stopped paying the school fees of the minor children and did not sign on the admission form due to which the minor son had to study in a government school for one year due to which, minor son suffered huge mental trauma. The respondent no. 1 also tried to stop the admission of minor girl and wrote emails to the school of the minor girl not to give her any transfer certificate just to torture and harass the appellant and did not even bother once regarded the impact on the mental health and education of minor girl child. vii) That the interim maintenance ordered to the by Ld. Trial Court, is totally unreasonable and on lower side. viii) It is prayed that impugned order dated 03.10.2023 passed by Ld. Trial Court, be modified and enhancement of Rs. 2,50,000/- be orders in favour of the appellant. It is also prayed that respondent no. 1 be directed to pay school fees, education expenses including uniform, travel, books, etc. It is further prayed that respondent no.1 CA No. 09/2024 Aradhana Srivastava Vs. Vivek Virendra Singh Page no. 8 of 13 be directed to handover the medical cards to the appellant and her minor children to claim cashless facility and also directed to pay the house rent separately to the owner along-with litigation cost and lumpsum monetary compensation to the complainant/ appellant. 6. Ld.
texts.arguments: Counsel for appellant herein has further argued that impugned order is vitiated by fatal infirmities and argued that impugned order dated 03.10.2023, passed by Ld. Trial Court, be [LEAKAGE_MASK]. Aradhana Srivastava vs Vivek Virendra Singh on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40890879/ 4 7. Ld. Counsel for the respondents has argued that impugned order passed by Ld. Trial Court, is legally correct and needs no interference. Further, that the complainant is a practicing lawyer and is earning sufficient for herself. Further, the respondent is taking care of all the expenses of the two minor children including their school fees, foreign trips, tuition fees, stationary expenses, school van, school registration fee, education policy for girl child Riya Singh, miscellaneous expenses and also paying EMIs for the personal loans taken of Rs. 14 Lacs for the education of his children. Apart from the aforesaid expenses, the respondent no. 1 is also taking care of the medical expenses and paying EMI installment for the house which was situated at Banjara Hills, Hydrabad. It is further argued that the respondent has provided one Hyundai I-20 Car and is also paying EMIs for the same. It is argued that the respondent has never shied away from the responsibility of CA No. 09/2024 Aradhana Srivastava Vs. Vivek Virendra Singh Page no. 9 of 13 taking care of the complainant and the minor children and therefore, the order of Ld. Trial Court does not require any interference. 8. 10. The Act inter-alia provides for more effective protection or the right of woman guaranteed under the constitution who are victims of the domestic violence of any kind occurring within the shared household. According to the Act, any harm, injury to health, safety, life, limb or well being or any other act or threatening or coercion etc. by any adult member of the family, constitutes domestic violence. Further, the act also contemplates that any woman who is or has been in a domestic relationship, if she is subjected to any domestic violence can file a complaint u/sec. 12 of the PWDV Act. This Act also covers those woman who are or have been in relationship with the abuser where Aradhana Srivastava vs Vivek Virendra Singh on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40890879/ 5 Ld. Trial Court vide impugned order, while considering the annual income of complainant and respondent and CA No. 09/2024 Aradhana Srivastava Vs. Vivek Virendra Singh Page no. 11 of 13 other facts and circumstances of this case, has not only directed the respondent no. 1 to continue to pay the educational/ school fee of minor children by depositing the same directly to the school but also directed to pay Rs. 90,000/- for the maintenance of the complainant as well as minor children from the date of filing of the petition i.e. 06.06.2022 till the disposal of the case on merits, to the complainant.
